escalation_teams.description: Requests tied to specific individual policy numbers, member disputes, corporate billing contracts, or dedicated insurance sponsor accounts.
Any inquiry touching medical judgment, medication dosages, diagnosis interpretation, or patient symptoms. The assistant MUST NOT provide clinical advice.
Requests involving sensitive PII, Medico-Legal Case (MLC) files, regulatory audit non-conformances, or privilege elevation requests.
Requests with ambiguous phrasing, multiple conflicting intents, or incomplete context where automated parsing cannot safely deduce user goal.
Requests where the system parsed the intent but retrieval confidence is below threshold (<70%) or policies contain conflicting departmental rules.

routing_rules.message: Clinical inquiries touch medical judgment and must not be answered by an operational assistant. Escalated to Clinical Review Board.
Sensitive legal, compliance, or access-override inquiry detected. Escalated to Compliance & Senior Operations.
Member-specific payer account request routed to Account Management Team.
